The epitope for Fab ZCP4C9 on the Omicron BA.5 spike trimer was determined by single particle reconstruction cryo-electron microscopy at a global resolution of 3.68 Å with local resolution of the Fab/RBD interface to 3.86 Å.

The epitope-specific mAb ZWD12 competed the binding of mAb ZWD11 to SARS-CoV-2 S, indicating they recognize an overlapping epitope.
